$comment: Deterministic policy for the scheduled APEX website intake administrator. 1.1 (2026-09-24): observer-page-transient (rendered-page timeouts, page 5xx, images failed to render) goes to the website agent operator to verify; observer-link-cta routes application-route findings to hubspot-program-admin; protocol 1d runs inside intake (an unregistered or ambiguous owner role is Blocked on the website agent operator with the role named), see agent/intake-policy.mjs resolveDecisionOwner. Ticket requirements remain in ticket-classes.json; this file says who must supply each input, what administrative queue receives a complete ticket, and which requests require review or are refused. The agent never edits the website. 1.2 (2026-09-25): an owner rule may name checkIds or requirementIds instead of (or as well as) a text pattern; the approved-media rule sends open-intro-media-approved, campus-page-stale-launch-media and campus.intro.media.current findings to website-operations, the owner of registry/campus-open-media.json (repair plan 2026-09-25, repair 1). A derivable field may name missingRegistryOwnerRole: when the registry it derives from has no entry for the campus, the ticket is Missing Info to that role (outcome missing-registry, the registry owner assigned, the ask on the ticket), never needs-derivation to internal triage (presence, not absence; repair plan 2026-09-25 repair 1).

siteScope.excludedPattern: \b(?:Waypoint(?: Academy)?|Texas Sports Academy|Alpha High(?: School)?|Nova(?: Academy)?|NextGen)\b
siteScope.reason: Version 1 governs the Alpha public WordPress site only. Sister-brand and separately hosted school tickets require their own playbook and must not be administered by this intake agent.

statuses.allowed: The request type is allowed to enter its named execution or owner queue when all inputs are present.
statuses.internal-review: A named human owner must approve or reshape the request before execution.
statuses.disallowed: The request conflicts with an explicit website control; intake records the reason and routes it for disposition rather than executing it.

pageUrl.reason: Resolve from APEX targetUrl, the selected Program, or registry/campus-pages.json; never ask for a URL already known to the system.

requirement.label: Team member name
requirement.prompt: Provide the team member's full public name.

requirement.label: Team member email
requirement.prompt: Provide the team member's Alpha email address so APEX and the WordPress worker can identify the exact person.

requirement.label: Public title
requirement.prompt: Provide the exact title that should appear publicly.

requirement.label: Biography
requirement.prompt: Provide the approved biography text for this team member.

requirement.label: Headshot
requirement.prompt: Upload the approved headshot for this team member. The file must be attached to this APEX request; Slack, Drive, and deck links are not accepted by the WordPress agent.

requirement.label: Exact requested change
requirement.prompt: State the current value, the exact replacement or outcome, and what should remain unchanged.

requester.reason: APEX must carry a requester email. Without one, intake cannot create a safe clarification round.

observed.reason: The observer or filing agent must record the public observation; do not ask a staff requester to reconstruct it.

expected.reason: Derive from the compiled playbook requirement or authoritative source.

observerId.reason: The observer must supply its durable finding identifier.

sourceValue.reason: Read the named authoritative source; do not ask the requester for a value already held in HubSpot, APEX, or another registry.

approvedMedia.reason: Resolve only from the approved media registry or an approved APEX asset.
approvedMedia.missingRegistryReason: registry/campus-open-media.json has no approved open-state media for this campus; website operations records the card or the approved video (spec/source-authority.json fields/campus.intro-media).

destinationUrl.reason: Resolve from the named source owner or source-of-truth field; do not ask for a URL APEX or HubSpot already holds.

requirement.label: One request per team member
requirement.prompt: Create one team-member request per person with that person's approved headshot, title, and biography attached, then paste the new APEX request IDs here. The combined roster will be held for internal review and never sent straight to website execution.

ownerRules.pattern: public (?:flag|state)|program interest|HubSpot Marketing Event|make (?:this |the )?event public|\bmade? (?:it |this |the event )?public|make_public
ownerRules.reason: The HubSpot event record is the failing source.
The WordPress event import or display layer is the failing surface.
Community identity or routing is controlled outside WordPress.
The growth-map owner controls map rows and destinations.

guards.pattern: decide one page or two|decision needed
guards.reason: The website identity decision must be made before n8n can receive an exact proposed derivation.

conditionalRequired.reason: A staff update that changes or supplies a photo needs the exact verified APEX headshot asset.
A staff update that changes or supplies a biography needs the approved biography text.
A staff update that changes the public title needs the exact approved title.

guards.reason: Campus staff may supply destinations but do not control page structure or add local functionality. Use the approved CTA model instead.

ownerRules.reason: The approved open-state intro media is a registry value website operations owns (registry/campus-open-media.json, spec/source-authority.json fields/campus.intro-media); a missing or unapproved card is Missing Info to that owner, never a page fix for the operator (repair plan 2026-09-25, repair 1).

ownerRules.pattern: submission_campus|Apply stays on the HubSpot form|application route
ownerRules.reason: The application route (submission_campus, the Program admission_link, the Finalsite redirect) is admissions territory; the page CTA follows the Program (B1 and E2 partitions, 2026-09-24).
The HubSpot event record is the failing source.

guards.reason: The request also names a structural, shared, functional, or sensitive change; website operations separates that scope before execution.

duplicates.reason: Exact duplicate candidates are linked and held for review; intake never auto-closes one.
